Question:
A real-valued function \(f\) has the property that for all real numbers \(a\) and \(b,\)

\[ \begin{gathered} f(a+b)+f(a-b) \\ =2f(a)f(b). \end{gathered} \]

Which one of the following cannot be the value of \(f(1)?\)
